title: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 30% Cashback on Minimum $200.01 Spend, Capped at $100 Per Member @ TopCashback AU
body:
Deal: Everyday Market from Woolworths: 30% Cashback on Minimum $200.01 Spend, Capped at $100 Per Member @ TopCashback AU

[A female dog] feel like pure sh*t, just want $150 cap back
[altomic] it's a $200.01 min spend to get 30% cash back (capped at $100)
otherwise Spend $50 to $200 gets 5% cash back
[jv] What will stop me getting my cashback
A machete attack.
[jv] Until this government fixes the problem they've caused …. Then yes…
[ozbmm] Delivery included in the calc and threshold?
[bamzero] Wasn't included in the cashback last time I got something so I'd say no to all
[Ash-Say] It's 30 minutes but yet to be tracked. It is generally very quick to track within 10 to 15 mins
[Jojamc] does shopback ever have 30% or is it just TCB?
[sssx] They have in the past. In 2024 + 2025 I purchased at 28, 30, 32, and 35% from SB, but in 2026 I've only purchased at 28%. Not sure if they've gone higher this year. Can probably search OzB.
[bob19] NB: Min spend is $200.01 for getting a 30% cashback
[gimmedealspls] Rookie question - So as long as it has everyday marketplace logo (the house with the circle around it), it doesn't matter who is it's sold by ?
So this would be OK ? https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1121162871…
So what is excluded then ?
[kudoz] Remember kids, DON'T CLICK OR USE ANY OFFERS FROM WOOLWORTHS EVEN IF IT'S ON THEIR SITE!
Was very lucky I managed to cancel the transaction last time before it shipped… all because I clicked the free shipping code in the woolworths checkout…
[tightarse] Hi guys,
I've checked and can see that no orders have reported since 13:50 AEST today across the network responsible for Everyday Market, BWS and a number of other merchants. Some orders prior to this time have also been delayed.
I can only assume their API has stalled for some reason. I've already flagged this with them, but haven't received a response as yet.
Please note that issues like this don't affect the underlying transactional data. They simply delay the transactions being reported through to us, so there's no concern around orders being lost.
If and when I hear more, I'll be sure to keep you updated.
Cheers!
Edit 17:05 AEST: Transactions are now starting to filter through. Thank you for your patience👍
[SpendLess] Edit: All good came through. Took 30min if anyone else wants to know.
@tightarse How long does it usually take for tracking to come through? I did get a pop up from the browser saying it did register that I went to the everyday site. I purchased about 25min ago
Also the app I've downloaded is always in German. Is there a way to fix this?
Thanks
[acersaurus] Be wary of these 30% back everyday market offers, they missed my claim on a $379 tv, then I lodged a missing cashback claim - it was granted but instead of giving me the 30% owed (around $100) they gave me $18.95
[tightarse] Hi. This was an issue with Woolies reporting the incorrect promo rate to us for a number of claims. They are in the process of being amended once Woolies provides us with the updated transactional validation file. Thank you.
[Nalar] Same boat, waiting to hear back after maybe 4 weeks since lodging the claim and the amount not matching the promo rate then me sending a question back and waiting for a while longer…..meanwhile Shopback responded to my claim and made it pending for the correct amount in about a week.
[KarnageX] Yup!
I share the same experience, logged a claim and they only gave back 5% instead of the promo 30% (this was for 26th June 2026 promo).
Now have to wait again, likely another 2 months before I hear back. So whoever is temped with this, take screenshots and evidence as proof.
[popbelly] Is this over $200 per item? If I have a cart with 2 items totalling over $200 will it track? Thanks
[A female dog] As long as the total (less shipping) is >$200, you will qualify for 30% cb (subject to tracking)
[Ruby321] Bought a 5TB WD My Passport HDD for $327, already got $94.74 at pending, bring it down to $230, very happy with it, although I have some gift cards from WWS but couldn't use it
[trishmapow] Wow, bought for $150 in 2022, crazy hike.
[Mega Frugal] Will earning rewards points on the purchase affect my cash back and tracking? My Woolies account is automatically linked to my rewards card. Do I need to remove this before I make payment?
[Oofy Doofy] What to buy, though?
I need an ideas boy or girl to help me out here
[Zeee] $100 cap. No thanks… They should advertise like 60% off cap at $50 minimum spend 300
[yoquierotaco] Hmm…just purchased yesterday an item. No cancellation button…
[Switchblade88] Sent my order through for a Moto G86 @ $350. It was through 'Horizon Store' rather than Mobilciti or Big W; never heard of them so we'll see how it goes
[Switchblade88] Half an hour and still no tracking…
@tightarse did the API break again? Or are you getting hammered with lots of traffic?
[SpendLess] Bit late now but the moto edge 60 fusion $399 from Mobilciti
[Spector1] Can someone please tell me if these are eligible? https://www.woolworths.com.au/shop/productdetails/1126888993…
Also is the seller legit?
Edit: tracked, I hope they’re real
[Venom] Not Top cashback itself but I would be very cautious with everyday markets, super dodgy!
